Aqueous hydrogen peroxide, H2O2, decomposes to produce water and oxygen gas.
Manganese(IV) oxide is a catalyst in this reaction.
A student adds powdered manganese(IV) oxide to aqueous hydrogen peroxide in a conical flask
as shown in Figure 4.1. The volume in the gas syringe is measured at regular time intervals. The
volume increases as time increases.
